question.zh: 弗兰克的第一份工作是什么？

sentences.zh: 弗兰克的第一份工作是什么？

sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: Frank Hawkins was telling me about his experiences as a young man.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·霍金斯向我讲述了他年轻时的经历。

chunks.x: about his experiences as a young man

sentences.en: Before he retired, Frank was the head of a very large business company, but as a boy he used to work in a small shop.
sentences.zh: 退休前弗兰克是一家很大的商业公司的经理，但他小时候却在一家小店里做工。

chunks.x: of a very large business company

sentences.en: It was his job to repair bicycles and at that time he used to work fourteen hours a day.
sentences.zh: 他的工作是修理自行车，那时他每天要工作14个小时。

sentences.en: He saved money for years and in 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
sentences.zh: 他积攒了好几年的钱，1958年买下了自己的一个小车间。

sentences.en: In his twenties Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
sentences.zh: 二十多岁时，弗兰克曾生产飞机零件。

sentences.en: At that time he had two helpers.
In a few years the small workshop had become a large factory which employed seven hundred and twenty-eight people.
sentences.zh: 几年后，小车间变成了雇有728人的大工厂。

chunks.x: which employed seven hundred and twenty eight people

sentences.en: Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years and the long road to success.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克回想起早年的艰辛和通往成功的漫长道路时笑了。

chunks.x: when he remembered his hard early years and the long road to success

sentences.en: He was still smiling when the door opened and his wife came in.
sentences.zh: 他还在微笑时，门开了，妻子走了进来。

chunks.x: when the door opened and his wife came in

sentences.en: She wanted him to repair their grandson's bicycle!
sentences.zh: 她要他去修理孙子的自行车！

chunks.x: him to repair their grandson 's bicycle
